game: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games
project: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays the intro, the title (A+B) and the save-data menu. 52-55 fps in the tested menus on both machines (the game's own pacing there). Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
